name: Trinidad to Klamath River

map.locality_method: Northern outer-coast discovery extent from the Mad River mouth past Trinidad Head and Reading Rock to the Klamath River, filling the gap between the Humboldt Bay–Cape Mendocino and Crescent City packages. This rectangle is not a legal fishing boundary, qualified spot or navigation clearance.

harbor.name: Trinidad Harbor and Pier
harbor.entrance_note: Trinidad is an open roadstead in the lee of Trinidad Head with a seasonal hoist and launch, not a protected bar harbor. Swell, wind and launch hours govern access; tide level is not launch or anchorage clearance.

stations.tide_note: Trinidad Harbor is a subordinate prediction station referenced to Crescent City; it predicts water level, not swell, surge at the launch or bottom drift.
